name: The Relinked row badge, as viewer: a bookmark the identity service moved onto another copy of its film by a provider-id match (Strong) shows 'Relinked, check position' with 'Looks right' in the My bookmarks section of the copy's details page; Looks right (the rename with the unchanged name) clears the mark, the name and the video stay. Run by bookmarks-rows-probe.mjs after it made the relink: viewer's bookmark named 'rows-probe Moved' on Same Id Remake (1999), the 1999 copy held out and scanned, put back and scanned.

steps.name: find the 2005 copy of Same Id Remake
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Same Id Remake', Fields: 'Path' })).Items.filter(i => /Same Id Remake \(2005\)/.test(i.Path || '')).map(i => i.Id)[0]

steps.name: the relinked bookmark on it
steps.eval: ((list) => { const b = list.find(x => x.Name === 'rows-probe Moved'); return b && b.Relinked === true && !b.Detached ? b.Id : null; })(await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.copyId })))

steps.name: there is one
steps.message: no relinked bookmark named 'rows-probe Moved' on the 2005 copy; run bookmarks-rows-probe.mjs

steps.name: its row: the badge 'Relinked, check position' with Looks right; still playable
steps.waitFor: ((r) => !!r && r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent === 'rows-probe Moved' && [...r.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-badge')].map(b => b.textContent).join('|') === 'Relinked, check position' && !!r.querySelector('.jfbm-badge-relinked') && r.querySelector('.jfbm-looks-right').textContent === 'Looks right' && r.querySelector('.jfbm-time-button').disabled === false && !r.classList.contains('jfbm-row-detached'))(document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.bookmarkId + '"]'))

steps.name: the badge's colour (the kit's warning colour) and tooltip
the badge and Looks right are gone
the server: not relinked any more, the same name and video
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
